UK Fintech: Emerging Growth
2021 Trends
Along with our friends at Deloitte, we’ve taken a look at the UK’s fintech
sector to explore emerging growth trends, which may be indicative of
where the fintech industry is heading.

The number of equity deals into fintech companies
has climbed every year over the last decade (2012-
2021).
There was a healthy level of seed-stage investment
for fintech in 2021, and examining these deals may
be indicative of where the fintech industry is
heading.
Here, we explore emerging subsectors such as
ethical investing, financial inclusion, sustainability
and internationalisation.
